senses.definition: the ability to hit or reach an exact point, as of a throw, a shot, or a movement of the hand
senses.definitionCN: 击中或到达某一确定点的能力，如投掷、射击或手部动作
senses.example: The archer practised daily to improve her accuracy.
senses.exampleCN: 弓箭手每天练习以提高命中精度。
senses.why: This is the image at its most physical: the mark is fixed, and accuracy is how near the arrow comes to it.
senses.whyCN: 这是这个画面最实体的一面：靶心固定不动，准确度就是箭离它有多近。

senses.title: Faithfulness in describing facts
senses.definition: the quality of representing facts or details without distortion, omission, or addition
senses.definitionCN: 呈现事实或细节时不歪曲、不遗漏、不添加的性质
senses.example: The reporter questioned the accuracy of the official statement.
senses.exampleCN: 记者质疑官方声明的准确性。
senses.why: A description is aimed at the facts as an arrow is aimed at a target; accuracy is how close the words land.
senses.whyCN: 描述像箭瞄准事实，准确度就是言辞落点离事实有多近。

senses.title: In computing: freedom from error
senses.titleCN: 计算或数据处理中的准确度
senses.definition: of a calculation, model, or system, the degree to which its output is free from error
senses.definitionCN: 计算、模型或系统的输出没有误差的程度
senses.example: The accuracy of the model fell sharply when the input data were noisy.
senses.exampleCN: 输入数据有噪声时，模型的准确度大幅下降。
senses.why: Numbers can miss a mark too, so the arrow image applies just as well to the output of a machine.
senses.whyCN: 数字也会脱靶，所以「箭与靶」的画面同样适用于机器的输出。

senses.title: In statistics: closeness to the true value
senses.definition: in statistics, the closeness of a measured or estimated value to the true value, as opposed to mere consistency
senses.definitionCN: 统计上测量值或估计值与真实值的接近程度，与单纯的稳定性相对
senses.example: Accuracy and precision are separate ideas: a reading can be steady and still wrong.
senses.exampleCN: 准确度与精密度是两个概念：读数可以很稳定却仍然错误。
senses.why: The true value is the target, and accuracy counts only the distance from it, not how tightly the shots cluster.
senses.whyCN: 真实值就是靶心，准确度只算离靶心的距离，不管弹着点聚得多紧。

senses.title: In language: correctness of usage
senses.definition: the quality of using words, grammar, or pronunciation correctly according to an accepted standard
senses.definitionCN: 按公认标准正确使用词语、语法或发音的程度
senses.example: Teachers mark accuracy in grammar separately from fluency.
senses.exampleCN: 教师把语法上的准确性单独于流利度来评分。
senses.why: A standard of usage serves as the target, and accuracy measures how closely a speaker's words follow it.
senses.whyCN: 语言规范充当靶心，准确度衡量的是说话人的用词离它有多近。

senses.title: In sport: proportion of successful attempts
senses.definition: the proportion of attempts that hit the target, used as a measure of a player or a weapon
senses.definitionCN: 命中目标的尝试所占比例，用来衡量球员或武器的表现
senses.example: His accuracy from beyond the line reached forty percent.
senses.exampleCN: 他的远投命中率达到百分之四十。
senses.why: When many arrows are loosed, accuracy becomes a count: how many of them found the mark.
senses.whyCN: 箭射得多了，准确度就变成一种计数：有多少支真的找到了靶心。

intro.en: Accuracy is formed in English from the Latin adjective accurate, and both go back to a Latin noun for care.
intro.cn: accuracy 在英语中由拉丁语形容词 accurate 加后缀构成，两者都追溯到表示「用心」的拉丁语名词。

items.en: Cura meant care, concern, and careful attention. It is also the source of cure and curious, whose meanings later moved away from simple care.
items.cn: 拉丁语 cura 意为「关心、照料、用心」，也是 cure 与 curious 的来源，后两者词义已偏离「用心」。

items.en: Ad- plus curare, from cura, formed accurare, to do something with care or to attend to it closely.
items.cn: ad- 与出自 cura 的动词 curare 构成 accurare，意为「用心去做、细心处理」。

items.en: The participle accuratus meant carefully done, exact, or precise; the prefix strengthened the sense of care.
items.cn: 分词 accuratus 意为「用心做成的、精细的、精确的」，前缀加强了「用心」的程度。

items.en: English adopted accurate in the sixteenth century and made the noun accuracy from it in the seventeenth. Exact first dates are uncertain.
items.cn: 英语在十六世纪引入 accurate，十七世纪由它构成名词 accuracy；确切首见年代不确定。

items.en: Accuracy spread from careful execution to measurement, statistics, language teaching, and sport.
items.cn: accuracy 从「用心做成」扩展到测量、统计、语言教学与体育运动。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers forms of the same cura family and one word whose meaning drifted; the near-meaning group gathers words for exactness and correctness.
note.cn: 形近组收同一 cura 词族的各种形式，以及一个词义已漂移的同根词；近义组收表示精确与正确的词。

entries.definition: Correct and exact, with no errors; the adjective from which accuracy is formed.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「准确的、精确的」，accuracy 正是由它加 -cy 构成。

entries.definition: In an exact and correct way; the adverb formed with -ly.
entries.definitionCN: 副词，义为「准确地、精确地」，由 accurate 加 -ly 构成。

entries.definition: The state of being wrong or inexact, or a particular error.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「不准确、误差之处」，由本词加否定前缀 in- 构成。

entries.definition: The quality of being exact, a rarer noun than accuracy.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「精确性」，由 accurate 加 -ness 构成，比 accuracy 少用。

entries.definition: Eager to know or learn; it comes from the same Latin cura but moved from care to inquiry.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「好奇的」，同出拉丁语 cura，但词义从「用心」转向「求知」。

entries.definition: The quality of being exact and consistent; it stresses repeatability more than closeness to the truth.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「精密、精确」，强调重复测量的一致性，而非与真实值的接近程度。

entries.definition: The quality of being completely correct in every detail.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「精确、分毫不差」，强调每个细节都完全正确。

entries.definition: The state of being right according to a rule or standard, without the measuring image.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「正确性」，指符合规则或标准，不带「测量」的画面。

entries.definition: Faithfulness to an original, as of a recording, translation, or account.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「忠实、保真度」，多用于录音、译文或记述与原件的相符程度。

normalIntro.en: These hooks use the real Latin noun for care and the phrases the word actually appears in.
normalIntro.cn: 下面这些钩子使用真实的拉丁语「用心」名词，以及这个词实际出现的搭配。

normal.en: Cura is care: accurate work is work done with care, and accuracy is the result of that care.
normal.cn: cura 是「用心」：accurate 的工作是用心做的工作，accuracy 就是这份用心带来的结果。

normal.en: The family runs accurate, accurately, accuracy and inaccuracy, all sharing one cura root.
normal.cn: 这一族包括 accurate、accurately、accuracy 与 inaccuracy，都共享同一个 cura 词根。

normal.en: Measurement accuracy is the phrase used for how close an instrument comes to the true value.
normal.cn: measurement accuracy 指仪器读数与真实值接近到什么程度。

normal.en: In statistics, accuracy and precision are deliberately kept apart.
normal.cn: 在统计里，accuracy 与 precision 被有意区分开来。

normal.en: Pinpoint accuracy is the strongest everyday phrase for hitting an exact point.
normal.cn: pinpoint accuracy 是日常英语里表示「分毫不差击中」最强的说法。

abstract.en: Picture an arrow in the centre of a target: the ring it lands in is the measure of accuracy.
abstract.cn: 想象一支箭插在靶心：它落在哪一环，就是准确度的度量。

abstract.en: The target can be a true value, a fact, a grammar rule, or a basket; accuracy is always the distance from the mark.
abstract.cn: 靶心可以是真实值、事实、语法规则或篮筐；accuracy 始终是离靶心的距离。

abstract.en: Care is the invisible cause: where someone attends closely, the arrow tends to land near the centre.
abstract.cn: 「用心」是看不见的原因：有人细心照看的地方，箭往往落得离靶心更近。

examples.en: The accuracy of the translation was checked by two native speakers.
examples.cn: 这份译文的准确性由两位母语者核对过。

examples.en: Modern instruments can measure temperature with great accuracy.
examples.cn: 现代仪器能以极高的准确度测量温度。

examples.en: He threw the ball with surprising accuracy for a beginner.
examples.cn: 作为初学者，他投球的准确度出人意料。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「阿克瑞西」——阿克一箭正中靶心，乐得拍手：准确、精准

root: 拉丁语 accuratus「用心做成的、精确的」来自动词 accurare，由 ad-「向、加强」+ curare「用心照料」构成，curare 出自 cura「关心、照料」。accuracy 是 accurate 加名词后缀 -cy 在英语中形成的。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses of accuracy all measure a distance from a mark: truth, a true value, a target, the facts, correct output, a statistical value, a language standard, and a goal in sport.
sensesIntro.cn: accuracy 的八个义项都在测量与某个靶心的距离：真相、真实值、靶子、事实、正确输出、统计值、语言规范与球场上的目标。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: an arrow lands in the centre of a target, with no gap between tip and mark.
core.cn: 核心意象：一支箭落在靶心，箭头与靶心之间没有缝隙。

branches.en: THE TRUTH LINE: an account or statement is aimed at the facts, and accuracy is how closely it lands.
branches.cn: 事实线：陈述或报道瞄准事实，accuracy 就是它落得有多近。

branches.en: THE MEASURE LINE: instruments and statistics are judged by distance from the true value, not by steadiness alone.
branches.cn: 测量线：仪器与统计以离真实值的距离来评判，而不只看稳定性。

branches.en: THE SPORT LINE: a single shot shows precision, while many shots turn accuracy into a percentage.
branches.cn: 运动线：单次射击体现精准，多次射击则把准确度变成百分比。

branches.en: THE MACHINE LINE: a model or calculation can miss the mark just as an arrow can.
branches.cn: 机器线：模型或计算也会像箭一样脱靶。

branches.en: THE LANGUAGE LINE: a usage standard is the target, and accuracy is adherence to it.
branches.cn: 语言线：用法规范是靶心，accuracy 就是对它的贴合程度。

intro.en: Accuracy combines a Latin adjective of care with the English noun suffix -cy.
intro.cn: accuracy 把表示「用心」的拉丁语形容词与英语名词后缀 -cy 组合起来。

latinIntro.en: Latin cura, curare and accuratus are recorded, so the family rests on attested forms rather than reconstruction.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 cura、curare 与 accuratus 均有文献记录，这一词族建立在有据可查的形式上，而非重构。

items.meaningCN: 向；朝向；也用作加强语气
items.example: The prefix adds direction and intensity to the care.
items.exampleCN: 这个前缀给「用心」加上方向和强度。

items.example: The noun is the source of the whole family.
items.exampleCN: 这个名词是整族词的源头。

items.example: The verb turns care into an action.
items.exampleCN: 这个动词把「用心」变成动作。

items.example: The participle is the direct base of accurate.
items.exampleCN: 这个分词是 accurate 的直接基础。

items.example: It marks the English adjective accurate.
items.exampleCN: 它标记英语形容词 accurate。

items.example: It turns accurate into accuracy.
items.exampleCN: 它把 accurate 变成 accuracy。

items.example: It forms accurately.
items.exampleCN: 它构成 accurately。

items.example: It forms inaccuracy.
items.exampleCN: 它构成 inaccuracy。

items.example: It forms accurateness.
items.exampleCN: 它构成 accurateness。

derivatives.zh: 由本词去掉 -cy 得到，义为「准确的、精确的」
由 accurate 加 -ly 构成，义为「准确地」
由本词加 in- 构成，义为「不准确；误差」

definition_zh: 控告；指控；指责；归咎
definition_en: to say that someone has done something wrong, illegal, or unacceptable, often in a formal or public way
core_image: 一根手指直指某人，把一桩错事摆到他面前
scene: 审讯室里，律师把一份记录推到桌面中央。The prosecutor accused the clerk of changing the records on purpose.
sceneCN: 这里 accused 是「指控」（第 1 个义项：正式指控某人做了错事）；句意为检察官指控那名职员故意篡改记录。

pos.zh: 及物动词：指控、控告；指责、归咎

derivatives.zh: 由动词 accuse 加名词后缀 -ation 构成，义为「指控；控告；指责」
由动词加 -er 构成施动名词，义为「指控者；控告人」
由名词 accusation 加 -ory 构成形容词，义为「指责的；控诉的」
由动词加 -ing 构成形容词，义为「带着指责意味的」

senses.title: To charge someone with a wrong
senses.titleCN: 正式指控某人做了错事
senses.definition: to state formally or publicly that a person has committed a wrong or a crime
senses.definitionCN: 正式或公开声明某人做了错事或犯了罪
senses.example: The prosecutor accused the clerk of changing the records on purpose.
senses.exampleCN: 检察官指控那名职员故意篡改记录。
senses.why: Latin causa means a case or a reason; to accuse is to bring a case against a person and name the reason.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 causa 意为「案件、理由」；accuse 就是把一桩案子摆到某人面前，并说出理由。

senses.title: To blame someone informally
senses.definition: to say or imply that someone is at fault, without any formal charge or procedure
senses.definitionCN: 在没有正式指控或程序的情况下说出或暗示某人有过错
senses.example: She accused me of forgetting her birthday again.
senses.exampleCN: 她又责怪我忘了她的生日。
senses.why: The same pointing gesture works at home and at court; here it is spoken in ordinary talk, with no case filed.
senses.whyCN: 同一个指点动作既能出现在法庭，也能出现在家里；这里只是日常说话，没有立案。

senses.title: To blame a thing or a condition
senses.definition: to blame something, such as a system, a tool, or a condition, for a failure or a problem
senses.definitionCN: 把失败或问题归咎于制度、工具、条件等非人的事物
senses.example: The report accused the old software of causing the delays.
senses.exampleCN: 报告把延误归咎于旧软件。
senses.why: A case can be brought against anything that looks like the cause, not only against a person.
senses.whyCN: 只要某物看起来是原因，案子就可以摆到它面前，并不限于人。

senses.title: In law: to bring a criminal charge
senses.definition: in law, to bring a charge against a defendant before a court
senses.definitionCN: 法律上在法庭上对被告提出指控
senses.example: The company was accused of fraud in three separate cases.
senses.exampleCN: 这家公司在三起不同案件中被控欺诈。
senses.why: In court the gesture becomes formal: the charge is stated, recorded, and then answered by the defence.
senses.whyCN: 在法庭上这个动作变得正式：指控被陈述、记录，然后由辩方回应。

senses.title: Of evidence: to point to guilt
senses.definition: of evidence, behaviour, or signs, to suggest that someone is responsible for something wrong
senses.definitionCN: 指证据、行为或迹象显示某人对某件错事负有责任
senses.example: The fingerprints accused him more clearly than any witness.
senses.exampleCN: 指纹比任何证人都更清楚地表明他有罪。
senses.why: Evidence can act like a pointing finger: it lays the case at a particular person's feet.
senses.whyCN: 证据可以像一根指人的手指：它把案子摊到某个人的脚边。

senses.title: To criticize in public
senses.definition: to criticize a person or group in public, often without proof, for something considered wrong
senses.definitionCN: 在公众场合批评某人或某群体做了不当之事，往往没有证据
senses.example: The newspaper accused the ministry of hiding the report.
senses.exampleCN: 报纸指责该部门藏起了那份报告。
senses.why: Public speech turns the pointing finger into a crowd's gesture, but the structure of naming a wrong stays the same.
senses.whyCN: 公开言论把个人的指点变成众人的手势，但「指出错事」的结构没有变。

senses.title: In the phrase the accused: the defendant
senses.titleCN: 短语 the accused 中的「被告」
senses.definition: in the fixed phrase the accused, the person or people charged in a criminal case
senses.definitionCN: 固定短语 the accused 指刑事案件中被指控的人
senses.example: The accused sat quietly while the evidence was read.
senses.exampleCN: 宣读证据时，被告安静地坐着。
senses.why: The past participle becomes a noun for the one against whom the case stands.
senses.whyCN: 过去分词转化为名词，用来指那个被人立了案子的人。

senses.title: To charge someone unjustly
senses.definition: to charge someone who is not at fault, so that the accusation itself becomes the wrong
senses.definitionCN: 指控一个并无过错的人，于是指控本身成了错事
senses.example: He was accused wrongly and spent two years clearing his name.
senses.exampleCN: 他被错误指控，花了两年时间洗清名声。
senses.why: The same pointing gesture can aim at an innocent person, and then the accuser is the one who commits the wrong.
senses.whyCN: 同一个指点动作也可能指向无辜者，这时犯错的反而是指控者。

intro.en: Accuse came into English from Old French, and its oldest layer is the Latin word for a legal case.
intro.cn: accuse 经古法语进入英语，它最古老的一层是表示「案件」的拉丁语词。

items.en: Causa meant cause, reason, and a legal case. The legal sense is the one that lies behind accuse.
items.cn: 拉丁语 causa 意为「原因、理由、案件」，其中「案件」这一层是 accuse 的来源。

items.en: Ad- plus causa, or the related verb causari, formed accusare, to bring a charge or call someone to account.
items.cn: ad- 与 causa（或相关动词 causari）构成 accusare，意为「提出指控、要求某人作出交代」。

items.en: Old French acuser meant to accuse, blame, or denounce, and it carried both the legal and the everyday senses at once.
items.cn: 古法语 acuser 意为「控告、责备、揭发」，法律义与日常义当时已经并存。

items.en: English borrowed the verb in the thirteenth century. The exact first written date is uncertain, and early spellings vary.
items.cn: 英语在十三世纪借入这个动词；确切首见年代不确定，早期拼写也不统一。

items.en: The courtroom charge and the household blame have stayed side by side, and public criticism joined them later.
items.cn: 法庭上的控告与家庭里的责备一直并存，公开批评的用法则是后来加入的。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers the accusare family and the related word for a pretext; the near-meaning group gathers verbs of charging and blaming.
note.cn: 形近组收 accusare 词族，以及一个同根但前缀不同的词；近义组收表示指控与责备的动词。

entries.definition: A statement or charge that someone has done something wrong.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「指控、控告」，指声称某人做错事的说法，由本词加 -ation 构成。

entries.definition: The person who makes a charge against another.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「指控者、控告人」，由本词加 -er 构成。

entries.definition: Expressing blame or a charge, as of a look, a tone, or a question.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「指责的、控诉的」，多形容眼神、语气或问题。

entries.definition: Carrying an implied charge, as in an accusing glance.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「带着指责意味的」，如指责的一瞥，由本词加 -ing 构成。

entries.definition: A reason offered to defend oneself; it shares the Latin causa root but takes the prefix ex-, out of the case.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「借口、辩解」，同出拉丁语 causa，但用前缀 ex- 表示「脱出案件」，词义已转向辩解。

entries.definition: To state officially that someone has committed a crime; the standard legal verb.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「控告、起诉」，是最标准的法律用语，正式程度高于 accuse。

entries.definition: To say that someone is responsible for something bad; it focuses on responsibility, not on a case.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「责备、归咎」，重点在责任归属，不带「立案」的意味。

entries.definition: To bring a formal criminal charge against someone, especially in American law.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「正式起诉、公诉」，属正式法律程序用语。

entries.definition: To state that something is true or that someone did something, without proof.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「声称、指称」，只陈述未证实的主张，不构成正式指控。

normalIntro.en: These hooks use the real Latin word for a case and the phrases the word actually appears in.
normalIntro.cn: 下面这些钩子使用真实的拉丁语「案件」一词，以及这个词实际出现的搭配。

normal.en: Causa is a case: to accuse is to put the case at someone's feet.
normal.cn: causa 是「案件」：accuse 就是把案子摆到某人面前。

normal.en: The prefix ac- is ad-, toward: the case is aimed at a particular person.
normal.cn: 前缀 ac- 是 ad-「朝向」：案子是朝着某个特定的人摆过去的。

normal.en: Accuse someone of doing something is the fixed pattern in both law and everyday speech.
normal.cn: accuse someone of doing something 是法律与日常语言共用的固定结构。

normal.en: The accused is the person the case stands against in court.
normal.cn: the accused 指法庭上被人立了案的那个人，即被告。

normal.en: Excuse shares the causa root but points the other way, out of the case.
normal.cn: excuse 共享 causa 词根，却朝反方向指去，意为「脱离案件」。

abstract.en: Picture a finger held steady at one person while a folder of reasons is opened.
abstract.cn: 想象一根手指稳稳指向某个人，同时一份写满理由的卷宗被翻开。

abstract.en: The folder can be a crime, a forgotten birthday, a faulty tool, or a public scandal.
abstract.cn: 那份卷宗可以是一桩罪案、一个被忘记的生日、一件出故障的工具，或一桩公开丑闻。

abstract.en: The gesture is not the proof: accusing names a case, and the case still has to be answered.
abstract.cn: 手势不等于证据：指控只是把案子摆出来，案子仍待回应。

examples.en: They accused the driver of running the red light.
examples.cn: 他们指控那名司机闯红灯。

examples.en: She accused him of taking the money without asking.
examples.cn: 她指责他没打招呼就拿走了钱。

examples.en: The report accused the system of ignoring small complaints.
examples.cn: 报告指责该体系忽视小额投诉。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「阿丘兹」——阿丘手指一点，把错事推到对方面前：指控、指责

root: 拉丁语 accusare「提出指控」由 ad-「向」+ causa「原因、案件」构成，causa 兼有「理由」与「诉讼案件」两义；古法语 acuser 把这个词带入英语，法律义与责备义一并保留。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses of accuse all point a finger: a formal charge, informal blame, blame of a thing, a criminal charge, evidence that points, public criticism, the defendant, and an unjust charge.
sensesIntro.cn: accuse 的八个义项都在「指人」：正式指控、日常责怪、归咎于物、刑事控告、证据指向、公开批评、被告，以及错误指控。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a finger points at one person while a case is laid out in front of them.
core.cn: 核心意象：一根手指指向某人，同时一桩案子被摆在他面前。

branches.en: THE COURT LINE: a case is stated formally, recorded, and answered by the defence.
branches.cn: 法庭线：案子被正式陈述、记录，并由辩方回应。

branches.en: THE EVERYDAY LINE: the same gesture becomes household blame, and it can also strike an innocent person.
branches.cn: 日常线：同一个动作成了家里的责怪，也可能落到无辜者身上。

branches.en: THE OBJECT LINE: a faulty tool or system can be blamed as if it were a defendant.
branches.cn: 归物线：出故障的工具或制度也会被当成被告一样归咎。

branches.en: THE EVIDENCE LINE: fingerprints and records point at a person more firmly than words do.
branches.cn: 证据线：指纹与记录比言辞更牢地把人指出来。

branches.en: THE PUBLIC LINE: a crowd repeats the gesture, and the accused becomes a name for the one charged.
branches.cn: 公众线：众人重复这个手势，而 the accused 成了被指控者的名称。

intro.en: Accuse is a French borrowing built on the Latin word for a case, with English suffixes making its family.
intro.cn: accuse 是建立在拉丁语「案件」一词之上的法语借词，英语后缀再扩展出词族。

latinIntro.en: Latin causa, causari and accusare are recorded, so only the deeper origin of causa is uncertain.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 causa、causari 与 accusare 均有文献记录，只有 causa 更早的来源不确定。

items.example: The prefix aims the case at a particular person.
items.exampleCN: 这个前缀把案子指向某个特定的人。

items.example: The noun gives the word its legal frame.
items.exampleCN: 这个名词赋予该词法律框架。

items.meaning: to plead, give as a reason
items.example: The verb family also produced excuse.
items.exampleCN: 这一动词词族也产生了 excuse。

items.example: It is the direct source of the English verb.
items.exampleCN: 它是英语动词的直接来源。

items.example: It forms accusation.
items.exampleCN: 它构成 accusation。

items.example: It forms accuser.
items.exampleCN: 它构成 accuser。

items.example: It forms accusatory.
items.exampleCN: 它构成 accusatory。

items.example: It forms accusing.
items.exampleCN: 它构成 accusing。

items.example: It forms excuse from the same root.
items.exampleCN: 它与同一词根构成 excuse。

derivatives.zh: 由本词加 -ation 构成，义为「指控；指责」
由本词加 -er 构成，义为「指控者；控告人」
由名词加 -ory 构成，义为「指责的；控诉的」
